How the model works

A

Begin

Two predefined people look up when the simulation starts.

B

Notice

Each person counts looking-up neighbors within the fixed 130-unit radius.

C

Update together

People who meet the threshold change at the end of the step, all at once.

A chosen model, not a human prediction. Proximity, the radius, and the exposure threshold are simplified assumptions selected to explore the phenomenon. They are not established facts about how people behave.
